Whether you're a student interested in joining, a parent with a question, or just want to learn more about Central York Science Olympiad, we'd be happy to hear from you.

## General Contact

### Email

The easiest way to reach us is by email:

**[scioly@cypanthers.org](mailto:scioly@cypanthers.org)**

For general questions about the team, competitions, joining, or anything else Science Olympiad-related, send us a message here.

### Instagram

Follow us on Instagram for team updates, competition results, announcements, and other Science Olympiad content:

**[@cyhsscioly](https://www.instagram.com/cyhsscioly/)**

## Interested in Joining?

CYHS students interested in joining Science Olympiad can reach out through the team email, contact one of our coaches directly, or simply register during club registration.

Whether you're already experienced with Science Olympiad or have never competed before, there are plenty of ways to get involved.
